key_insight: Ternary blending in RAINBOW solar cells significantly enhances power conversion efficiency (PCE) compared to traditional single-junction devices.
engineering_relevance: The RAINBOW architecture demonstrates a scalable method for producing high-efficiency organic photovoltaics (OPVs).
method: Tested 7 different binary material combinations with varying bandgaps.
Evaluated 5 different ternary blends for improved performance.
Fabricated devices using meniscus-guided blade coating.
evidence_signal: Efficiency improved from 12.9% in single-junction devices to 17.3% in 3-junction devices.
watch_item: The potential for high efficiency relies on the availability of wide bandgap materials (2-2.5 eV).
paper_title: Exploring the Potential of Ternary Blending for Two and Three-Junction RAINBOW Solar Cells
